cohort: The study included 134 clinically healthy mother-infant pairs from the 'Pius Brinzeu' Emergency County Clinical Hospital, Timisoara, all of whom had deliveries by cesarean section for maternal indications unrelated to fetal condition.
finding: Longer maternal telomere length was positively correlated with better neonatal growth parameters (birth weight, length, head circumference, gestational age) and vitality measures (Apgar scores), with shorter maternal TL independently predicting suboptimal 1-min Apgar scores.
